scripts.dev: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm -w @divyaloka/api run dev" "npm -w @divyaloka/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w @divyaloka/api run build && npm -w @divyaloka/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @divyaloka/api run typecheck && npm -w @divyaloka/web run typecheck
